title: アヤベさんのサンドウィッチ

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Today, Admire Vega and I are shopping for ingredients to make sandwiches.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's apparently preparing a lunchbox for tomorrow. I didn't hear this from her, however…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Haaah ha ha ha! I appear a fourth time!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Huh, Opera O! Today too?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …This is the fifth time. Not the fourth.

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: And many more times to come, Ayabe! That is…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Until you come to the Centurial Overlord's Truly Delightful Lunch Exchange!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Classmate A
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Opera O is so cute. She loves Ayabe just like the rest of us!

text_block_list.name: Ayabe's Classmate B
text_block_list.text: Will she show up tomorrow? If this starts being a regular thing, lunchtime will become my highlight of the day!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Um… Doto and I would love for you to come, Ayabe! Of course, it's up to you, though.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: But trying it once won't hurt, right? It's really fun trading lunch with everyone!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …And so, she apparently gave in.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: A homemade lunch trade… I'm not even that good at cooking to begin with.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I can only really make sandwiches.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sigh…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'd like to get your opinion on what I should make… if you don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Since someone else will be eating it, it's probably better to get someone else's opinion rather than go with my own preferences.
choice_data_list: Of course, I'm happy to help.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I take a look around thinking of how wholesome it is that Admire Vega's taking this seriously.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Something general and safe shouldn't be too difficult to find. She's only making a sandwich…

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Welcome, welcome! We have plenty of rare delicacies you can't find anywhere else!

text_block_list.name: Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: In the right hands, they're sure to add an element of surprise to your everyday cooking! Take your cooking to the next level!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Handled correctly, these ingredients could make for a supreme sandwich. But it's kind of risky, some of this stuff looks like it requires special treatment.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: So, what should I choose?
choice_data_list: Let's go with the exotic meat!
Let's go with the rare fish!
Let's go with the heirloom vegetables!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm sure her classmates will be happy even if we go with safe ingredients. I suggest some typical options.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Well, if it ain't Ayabe! I was wonderin' who'd be out here wearin' their uniform!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Tamamo… Hello.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Back at ya! So, are you two shoppin' today?
choice_data_list: We're looking to make a sandwich.
We're looking to make a sandwich.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Oooh, sandwiches! Not one for traditional lunchboxes, huh?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Now that ya mention it, I think I saw Creek makin' star-shaped sandwiches the other day. You plannin' to do somethin' like that too, Ayabe?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? No. I… do have a cutter, but…

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! But ya barely use it, right? Well, when ya do use, whatever does come out pretty cute.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I sometimes do that for the li'l squirts back home. They always get so happy too!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: And I like that I can snack on the cut-off bits! Hahaha!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …I imagine some of the younger students would enjoy sharing the sliced-off ends.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I definitely get it, but I don't know…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Hearing Tamamo Cross talk admiringly of her younger siblings, Admire Vega's expression softens a little.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's try a challenge! I suggest going with the meat.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Oh, hey, Ayabe! Are you lookin' for high-quality meat?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, not exactly…
choice_data_list: Are you looking for high-quality meat, Hishiama?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm gettin' some for Brian's lunch.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: She's always eatin' by that guide "Overcome Your Hate for Vegetables!" It's gotta be tough, right? You should treat yourself every once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: So, I thought I'd make somethin' super gourmet for meat lovers.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: And actually, we're competin' over who can make the best lunch, one-on-one! I swear I'll win, or my name's not Hishiama!
choice_data_list: It's nice to make something with another person in mind.
It's nice to make something with another person in mind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: It's essential when you're plannin' on givin' it to 'em!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks… I'll have to keep that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: Hm? Haha, well, if I helped, I helped!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I wonder if Admire Vega will keep someone in mind while making the sandwich.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it, the lunch trade gets underway, and…

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Oh, wow! Ayabe, did you really make this?! It tastes amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Mmm! It's so good! Like really, really, really good! Ahhh! It's just so good!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That vocabulary… Aren't you an honor student?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It's a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: She ate it all. She even said it was good.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Thanks for helping me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That went pretty well!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I… decided not to join.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The sandwich wasn't good enough to give to someone else…
choice_data_list: It's my fault for giving bad advice!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: No, it's not your fault. It was my decision in the end.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It just comes down to… my lack of skill.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That was disappointing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's try a challenge! I suggest going with the fish.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Oh! I thought I'd seen that celestial visage before! Adve— mean, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Hi… I have to go.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Immediately after respectfully returning the greeting, Admire Vega tries to leave with shockingly cool composure!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Hey, hey, hey! Where ya going?! At least listen to my next two lines!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I came here to buy groceries. I don't have time to mess around with you.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: As if I've spent all 365 days of the year goofing off 24-7 for the last 4.6 billion years! Which I have, mind you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: See? If you're going to be like that, this conversation's over.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Whoa, wait wait wait! At least tell me about the two types of comet tails! Come oooon!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …The ion tail is composed of gases, and the dust tail is self-explanatory. Okay, bye.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wait, last one! I swear! What's the constellation that holds the star from which Mira variable pulsating stars got their name?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Cetus. Are we done now?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Wh-what about the group of asteroids that share an orbit with Jup—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: The Trojan asteroids. Enough already!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: This probably doesn't sound like much coming from someone who kept breaking her promise, but the fact that you keep answering really speaks to your character.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Perhaps as a token of her appreciation, Gold Ship helps us select ingredients with her vast knowledge of seafood.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it, the lunch trade gets underway, and…

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ahh! What incredible flavor! What richness in tastes! This is the type of supreme sandwich the Overlord deseeeerves! ♪

text_block_list.name: T.M. Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wagner, Rossini, Verdi, and even Mozart would all rush to compose songs of praise after just one bite!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Thanks. But don't talk when you eat.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: …It's a huge success!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega

text_block_list.text: Yeah…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: That was disappointing…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Let's try a challenge! I suggest going with the vegetables.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh…

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: …Hello, Taishin.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hi…

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Um, are you shopping?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Yeah. And you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Well… everyone's been making a fuss about nutrition or whatever.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: You know what? Never mind.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Sure.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Actually… You were at class today, r—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: I mean… Nah, forget it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: …But actually, though, over there I saw some stuff that looks pretty easy to use.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Really? Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Neither of them says it out loud, but it seems like their sentiment toward their peers is oddly similar.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before we know it, the lunch trade gets underway, and…

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ohhh, w-wowie, it's so good! Y-you're so talented, Ayabe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I'll eat carefully and savor every bite! I won't drop even a crumb!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: That's a bit over the top.
